TXT_CODE_57d1929e: ElementsPanel will use the "Minecraft Ping protocol" to try to obtain the number of online servers, versions, delays and other information.
TXT_CODE_6b175558: After completing the configuration, the server status will be refreshed every minute when the instance is running.
TXT_CODE_2ab036a4: Please enter the game server port
TXT_CODE_8e2be926: Please enter the IP address of the game server, leave blank for the local host (localhost) by default.
MC_MAP_PAGE_ENABLE_HINT: Allow access to a standalone map page without signing in. Only the saves and dimensions listed below are available.
MC_MAP_EMBED_HINT: One origin per line (for example https://example.com). These sites may inject markers and a menu, and focus the map through postMessage inside an iframe. Leave empty to disable the bridge.
MC_MAP_EMBED_INVALID: Invalid origin; use a bare origin such as https://example.com.
MC_MAP_PAGE_SETTINGS_INVALID: Invalid public map settings. Check names, sources and access IDs; IDs must be unique.
MC_MAP_PAGE_DISABLED: The public map page is disabled.
MC_MAP_PUBLIC_MAPS_HINT: Choose saves/dimensions from a specific node and Minecraft instance. Only listed maps are public. Save settings after editing.
MC_MAP_PUBLIC_ID_HINT: Used in public links. Letters, digits, hyphens and underscores are allowed; leave blank to generate one. Changing it invalidates old links.
MC_MAP_PUBLIC_EMPTY: No maps are configured for public access.
MC_MAP_PUBLIC_NOT_FOUND: This map is not public or has been removed.
MC_MAP_NO_WORLDS: No readable Minecraft saves found. Generate and save a world first.
MC_MAP_SAVED: Shows saved terrain. Save server changes before refreshing.
MC_MAP_PARTIAL: Some chunks could not be read. Save the world and refresh.
MC_MAP_UNSUPPORTED_INSTANCE: This instance does not support saved world maps.
MC_MAP_NODE_OFFLINE: The node is offline. Check its connection.
MC_MAP_SESSION: Your session expired. Sign in again.
MC_MAP_READ_FAILED: Could not read the saved world map.
MC_MAP_WORLD_MISSING: The save was moved or deleted. Refresh the list.
MC_MAP_BUSY: The map is busy. Refresh shortly.
MC_MAP_CORRUPT: A chunk is corrupt or uses an unsupported format.
MC_MAP_SNAPSHOT: Could not create a Bedrock save snapshot. Save the world, refresh, and check free space in the node’s temporary directory.
MC_MAP_BEDROCK_READER: The Bedrock reader could not load. Install leveldb-zlib on the node; some platforms require a native build.
MC_PLAYERS_EMPTY: No known players. Enter a player name below to manage them.
MC_PLAYERS_STOPPED: Server stopped. Saved player lists are available; start the server to perform actions.
MC_PLAYERS_BEDROCK_LIMITS: Bedrock supports kicking, allowlists, operators, game modes and teleportation. Its dedicated server has no built-in ban command.
MC_PLAYERS_INVALID_NAME: Enter a player name without selectors, quotes or command characters.
MC_PLAYERS_INVALID_REASON: Reason must be at most 200 characters and contain no line breaks.
MC_PLAYERS_INVALID_COORDINATES: Enter valid coordinates: X/Z within ±30000000 and Y within ±2048.
MC_PLAYERS_INVALID_RESPONSE: The server returned an invalid player list.
MC_PLAYERS_NOT_RUNNING: The server must be running to perform this action.
MC_PLAYERS_NO_RESPONSE: The server did not confirm the command. Check the instance console before retrying.
MC_PLAYERS_COMMAND_FAILED: Could not execute the player command.
MC_PLAYERS_FILES_PARTIAL: Some saved player lists could not be read.
MC_PLAYERS_ACTION_UNSUPPORTED: This server edition does not support this action.
MC_PLAYERS_BUSY: A player request is in progress. Try again shortly.
MC_PLAYERS_ONLINE_UNAVAILABLE: The online list could not be read. Online status is unknown; check the instance console.
MC_PLAYERS_UNSUPPORTED_INSTANCE: This instance does not support player management.
MC_PLAYERS_SESSION: Your session expired. Sign in again.
MC_PLAYERS_QUERY_DISABLED: Java player lists require Query. Set enable-query=true in server.properties and restart the Minecraft server.
MC_PLAYERS_QUERY_PROMPT_TEXT: Query is disabled for this Java instance. Set enable-query=true in server.properties and restart the instance now? Restarting will disconnect online players.
MC_PLAYERS_QUERY_RESTART_REQUESTED: Query is enabled in the configuration and an instance restart was requested. Wait for the server to start, then refresh the list.
MC_PLAYERS_QUERY_WRITE_FAILED: Could not save Query settings; no restart was requested. Check file permissions, or refresh and retry if the configuration changed.
MC_PLAYERS_QUERY_RESTART_FAILED: Query is enabled in the configuration, but the restart request failed. Restart manually from the instance console.
MC_PLAYERS_QUERY_CONFIG: Could not read valid Query settings. Check server.properties, query.port (1–65535) and the server address.
MC_PLAYERS_QUERY_UNAVAILABLE: Query failed or timed out. Enable Query, restart the Minecraft server and make sure its query.port UDP port is reachable from the node.
MC_PLAYERS_QUERY_RESPONSE: Query returned an invalid or incomplete player list. Online status is unknown; check the server's Query player-list settings.
MC_MAP_SETTINGS_SAVED: Saved; public map settings are active
MC_MAP_SETTINGS_FORBIDDEN: Only administrators can configure public maps
MC_MAP_INSTANCES_EMPTY: No Minecraft instances on this page; search or change pages
MC_MAP_3D_EMPTY: No saved blocks nearby. Choose other coordinates or return to spawn.
MC_MAP_WEBGL_UNAVAILABLE: This browser cannot render the 3D scene. Returned to 2D; enable hardware acceleration and try again.
MC_MAP_SCENE_LIMIT: This scene is very complex. Nearby terrain takes priority; zoom in or move to explore further.
MC_MAP_PLAYERS_STOPPED: The server is stopped. Start it to show online players and positions.
MC_MAP_PLAYERS_POSITION_UNAVAILABLE: Some player positions could not be read. The server may not support entity data commands.
MC_MAP_PLAYERS_LIMIT: Only the first 512 online players are shown.
MC_MAP_RCON_DISABLED: RCON must be enabled to show online players and their positions.
MC_MAP_RCON_PROMPT_TEXT: Enable RCON in server.properties and restart this instance now? A random password will be generated if none is configured. Restarting disconnects online players.
MC_MAP_RCON_RESTART_REQUESTED: RCON is configured and a restart has been requested. Player positions will update after the server starts.
MC_MAP_RCON_UNSUPPORTED: This server does not support Java RCON player positions.
MC_MAP_RCON_BUSY: The instance is busy. Please try again shortly.
MC_MAP_RCON_CONFIG: Unable to read valid RCON settings. Check server.properties, rcon.port (1–65535), the password and server address.
MC_MAP_RCON_WRITE_FAILED: Unable to save RCON settings. No restart was requested. Check file permissions and retry after refreshing.
MC_MAP_RCON_RESTART_FAILED: RCON settings were saved, but the restart could not be requested. Restart the instance from the console.
MC_MAP_RCON_UNAVAILABLE: RCON connection failed or timed out. Check that RCON is enabled, the server has restarted, and its TCP port is reachable from the node.
MC_MAP_RCON_AUTH: RCON authentication failed. Check the configured password and restart the server if it changed.
MC_MAP_RCON_RESPONSE: The RCON player response was invalid or incomplete.
